resources.string: Includes system ISO countries and existing presets; not a TikTok service/account whitelist. Entries without a carrier preset set only the country code. State/province support is a separate model and is not inferred from a two-letter country code. SIM, language, timezone and GPS overrides can update subsequent platform reads without reopening TikTok. Previously cached host values or already-sent requests are not rebuilt or retracted; this does not translate the existing app UI.
Keep original carrier and SIM/phone state; do not invent MCC/MNC or a carrier name.
No environment preset: native values remain; select custom parameters if needed.
Follow-region language/timezone/GPS stays native if no preset exists. Custom values remain available. This does not change account region or network IP.
Use a two-letter country code. Carrier mode also requires a 5–6 digit MCC/MNC and a nonempty carrier name.
Could not save or synchronize settings. Check the current values and try again.
